This library is dynamically loaded privately and remains replaceable independently
of the mod. No OpenAL router, global installation or second hardware output device
is used. See COPYING (GNU Library General Public License version 2; upstream
sources permit version 2 or later), LICENSE-pffft, LICENSE-fmt, LICENSE-gsl and
BSD-3Clause. Unmodified SDK headers carry their own public-domain notices.

The built-in default HRTF in this pinned release is based on MIT Media Laboratory
KEMAR measurements by Bill Gardner and Keith Martin, copyright 1994. Their data
permits unrestricted use with author attribution. Attribution is retained here.
Data source/terms: https://sound.media.mit.edu/resources/KEMAR.html
Upstream description: HRTF.txt (from the matching source archive).

Mod cue WAVs are original deterministic procedural output of tools/generate_cues.py;
they do not contain game audio or the HRTF measurements. Custom WAV overrides are
loaded separately from the game-root sounds folder.
